title: A football optimization–enhanced deep learning framework with large language model guidance for desalination systems
summary: A football optimization–enhanced deep learning framework with large language model guidance for desalination systems Nature
body: A football optimization–enhanced deep learning framework with large language model guidance for desalination systems Nature
summaryZh: 《Nature》期刊发表了一项将大模型引导与足球优化算法相结合的深度学习框架，用于提升海水淡化系统的运行与优化效率。原始信息显示：A football optimization–enhanced deep learning framework with large language model guidance for desalination systems Nature。该消息由Nature发布，主题为“A football optimization–enhanced deep learning framework with large language model guidance for desalination systems”。其重要性主要体现在：该自然期刊研究展示了结合大模型指导的深度学习框架在海水淡化系统优化中的应用，属于学术前沿落地探索。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
